notes:
2026-10-18 review fail by reviewer: FAIL. Acceptance 1, 2 and 3 hold, but the mock makes one assertion meaningless.

Blocking: apps/web/e2e/privy/invoices.spec.ts:281 expects the send POST to answer 201, but the route mock at :268-275 always answers 201, so this check can never fail. Before F227 it was the only check that the API accepts the web's real request, including the Idempotency-Key header the API requires (400 without it, invoices_send_test.go:27). No web unit test checks that sendInvoice (apps/web/src/features/invoices/api/invoices-api.ts:99-112) sends that header; profiles-api.test.ts:58 and new-invoice-form.test.tsx:44 do this for other calls. Fix: assert the request's Idempotency-Key, for example a UUID from (await sent).request().headerValue("idempotency-key"), in place of or next to the 201 check.

Checked and fine:
- Accept 1: dev DB rows from the verify run (10:24-10:25 UTC) close after 24 h (desktop invoice), 1 h (phone invoice, 4 addresses), 27.6 h (desktop request, custom tomorrow 17:00) and 1 h (phone request). No other privy spec makes a real invoice or request: navigation and toasts use mockApi, onboarding mocks /api/v1/**, balances only reuses the E2E shop profile.
- Accept 2: no outbox_events rows of any kind since 10:00 UTC; the last invoice.sent row for E2E shop is from 03:50 UTC. The desktop invoice queues no reminder (due a month away, checkout closes in 1 day). TestSendInvoiceToClient (apps/backend/internal/httpapi/tests/invoices_send_test.go:14) has no skip and ran in the unit log.
- Mock shape: the /send mock answers the real owner GET plus sends: [queued], which matches invoiceSchema and invoiceSendSchema; the real Send also answers 201 with GetOfProfile. The toast, the Sending line, the hidden button and the focus move still test the UI: they need the mutation to succeed and the refetch to pass the owned mock.
- Accept 3: D-85 (docs/PROJECT.md:237) is accurate, each sentence 24 words or fewer; docs/web/architecture.md:99-100 states the rule; check-docs.py: 0 errors. No doc still says the e2e sends a real email.
- Comments in both specs are current (invoices.spec.ts:118, :260-261, :290-291, :492; money-requests.spec.ts:173).

Minor, not blocking:
- invoices.spec.ts:264: the owned-read mock is never unrouted, unlike the other mocks in this test (:359, :405). Later reads (reminders, duplicate, final Billed to check) only get sends replaced, so no later assertion is hidden. It also adds the send to any owner read before the click; adding it only after the /send handler ran would be tighter.
- docs/web/architecture.md:100 repeats D-85's two rules beside the D-85 link. Accept 3 asks for it, but D-84 prefers a link only.
- invoices.spec.ts:261 is 121 characters, like the existing line 21.
